pmfby.sum_insured_note: Sum insured is equal to Scale of Finance (SOF) fixed by District Level Technical Committee (DLTC).
pmfby.subsidy_sharing: Premium above farmer share is shared 50:50 by Central and State Governments (90:10 in North Eastern States).
pmfby.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare Operational Guidelines

kcc.scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) & Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS)
kcc.notes: Short-term crop production credit up to Rs 3 lakh available at 7% p.a.; with 3% prompt repayment incentive, the effective rate is 4% p.a.

pm_kisan.notes: Direct benefit transfer of Rs 6,000 per year in three 4-monthly installments of Rs 2,000 each to all eligible landholder farmer families.

msp_procurement.paddy_wheat_mechanism: FCI and State Agencies procure paddy and wheat at MSP under Decentralized Procurement Scheme (DCP).
msp_procurement.pulses_oilseeds_mechanism: NAFED and NCCF procure pulses and oilseeds under Price Support Scheme (PSS) when market prices fall below MSP.
msp_procurement.cotton_mechanism: Cotton Corporation of India (CCI) procures seed cotton (kapas) when prices dip below MSP.
msp_procurement.sugarcane_mechanism: Sugar mills are legally mandated to pay Fair & Remunerative Price (FRP) fixed under Sugarcane (Control) Order 1966.

input_subsidies.fertilizer_subsidy_note: Urea MRP is fixed statutorily; P&K fertilizers are subsidized under Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) scheme by Department of Fertilizers.
input_subsidies.micro_irrigation_pmksy: Per Drop More Crop scheme provides 55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers, and 45% for other farmers for drip and sprinkler systems.
input_subsidies.solar_pump_pmkusum: PM-KUSUM provides 60% subsidy (30% Centre + 30% State) for standalone solar agriculture pumps.
input_subsidies.source: Department of Fertilizers / Ministry of Jal Shakti / MNRE
